customers_say: Customers find the door lock easy to install, with one noting it fits perfectly on wooden door frames, and appreciate its multiple unlocking options and triple deadlocks for enhanced security. The lock adds a modern touch to the door and is convenient for the whole family, with one customer mentioning it saves hassle with keys. While the build quality and service receive positive feedback, customers have mixed opinions about the lock's smooth operation.

reviews.title: Value for money
reviews.body: Definitely a 9/10 lock. A couple of features could’ve been added like remote unlock without requiring the bell to be pressed but otherwise does all the work!

reviews.author: Padmaja
reviews.title: Best Lockpro by UC with latest features.
reviews.body: Very useful Digital lock especially for Sr citizens, who can operate with ease. It is safe & secured. We can see who is ringing our bell & can decide whether it is safe to open or not. It is also useful for young parents, frequent travellers & everyone. Now we can relax without any hesitation of leaving behind our valuables if any at home. I liked it.

The technician was also knowledgeable and very nice person also who guided us very well. Keep going urban clap. We request urban clap to provide a separate app for native door lock. Thank you
